title: ArcCivs175: captured-terrain growth repair and complete fifth-village planning
owner_requirement: Fix Village-1/2 development and find fifth village, using explicitly authorized captured terrain/plans and blacklist input policy.
proposed_change: After exact founding full34 HOUSE no-site failure, try one smaller same-style HOUSE family with validated real maximum envelope, existing catalog and existing full34/native proof. Repair existing growth only at replay-proven terrain/perimeter failures; reuse captured owned land and paid native construction.
physical_item_effect: Compact family changes future blueprint block/material bill under existing paid construction. Resident/bed/production rules, work rates and supplies targets remain unchanged. Resuming ordinary growth may change actual item throughput; unmeasured.
founding_item_effect: A newly founded fifth canonicalID receives existing one-time96OAK_LOG+96COBBLESTONE+24BREAD=216items. ExistingID repeat0. This reserve is not spendable currency or a repeatable reward.
assumptions: No new currency/XP reward, drop chance, shop rate or paid-work speed.
Participants1/4/5and0/1/2planningevents perday are sensitivity inputs, not measured player activity or new caps.
Existing Auto deficit restock and ordinary production remain real possible downstream item sources; no self-sufficiency or zero indirect effect claim.
Active EconomyShopGUI SELL and futureSHADOWcontracts are distinct and unchanged.
live_verification: Verify next ordinary paid construction for V1/V2 and fifth complete native founding. Preserve actual buildings/paidroutes/material accounting. No manualgrants/forcedarrivals/QA world edits to pass.

perimeter_repair.before: Retained centrelines were admitted but their actual dirt-path shoulders were excluded by separator clearance; an existing three-wide road can block its own planned gate.
perimeter_repair.after: Use existing infrastructure shoulder predicate: actual loaded dirtPath within1 of retainedroute, top==ground and grade±1. No change to paid/world authority, slopeproof or solverbudgets.

diagnostic_fix: Terrain export captures same water depth domain as existing runtime planner (core/gates/retainedgates); loaded-only bounded sampler unchanged.

approach_grading_repair.before: Captured full34 plan has one rejected seven-column ROAD despite nine loaded natural unoccupied exterior approaches; their raw ground is more than one step below the already graded road.
approach_grading_repair.after: Only unowned natural approaches may choose a floor within one step of the road edge and within existing Terraform.MAXIMUM_CHANGE of native ground. Accepted/generated/preserved route grades remain authoritative; occupied columns remain unavailable. The existing native terraform and paid construction journal must execute this grade.
approach_grading_repair.economic_effect: May change future paid earthwork and material consumption for an otherwise blocked road. No free world edits, supplies, work speed or direct currency/reward changes. Actual downstream throughput remains unmeasured.
